name: turnkeeper-sdk-monorepo
description: Public Turnkeeper Ward safety-intelligence contracts and detector adapters.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @turnkeeper/sdk && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:repository-boundary && npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:release-tools && npm run package:check --workspaces --if-present && npm run smoke:packages && npm run validate:public-surface
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:release-tools
